network.title: Network
network.description: Connect with students, alumni and companies.

impact.title: Real impact
impact.description: Students and THI staff use your work.

cost.a: Students pay €10 per year, everyone else €20. The fee is due once a year on 15 March. Members who are especially committed to the club can be exempted by the board.

thi.q: Do I have to study at THI?
thi.a: No. Anyone who supports the club's goals can become a member. Students pay a reduced fee.

experience.a: Not for every role. We teach practical and theoretical computer science, and besides development and infrastructure there are areas like marketing and HR where you won't write code.

time.q: How much time do I have to invest?
time.a: We work on a volunteer basis and you manage your own time. Every position lists roughly how many hours per week to expect.

joining.a: Super simple: just join our Discord. A ticket opens automatically, where we get to know you and your interests. If it feels right, you then submit your membership application. After that you get access to our internal platforms and can jump right into a project. We look forward to meeting you!

spontaneous.title: Nothing fitting? Become a member anyway.
spontaneous.description: You don't have to apply for a position. Join the club at any time, attend events and be part of the community. If you feel like getting involved, there is always something to do: just reach out on Discord.
